scope: Only current 35 FIRST_EXACT_SOURCE_PENDING identities; official FSSR identity and CTR named article comparisons; not a product approval
policy: Only two cases have direct statutory scope/threshold contradictions. Other rows document distinct marketed-food identities or FSSR definitions that block AUTOMATIC ingredient source transfer, not every possible legal application.

cases.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
cases.identity_evidence: FSSR 2.10.9 expressly defines purified vending-machine water as other than packaged drinking water or natural mineral water.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: The CTR packaged-drinking-water row is not an exact article for the FSSR 2.10.9 marketed identity. IS 10500 is referenced by the FSSR standard; independently verify the drinking-water analytical requirements.
cases.decisive_basis: FSSR separate legal definition and CTR packaged article
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Obtain official legal/technical route for non-packaged vending water and water sampling point.

cases.identity_evidence: Compliant dried glucose syrup under FSSR 2.8.7 has sulphated ash at most 1.0%; the compared CTR high-ash starch-conversion lead article requires sulphated ash exceeding 1.0%.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: These opposing thresholds cannot both hold for a compliant finished dried glucose syrup. Do not claim the low-ash product matches that high-ash named article.
cases.decisive_basis: FSSR maximum 1.0% vs CTR entry strictly >1.0%
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Determine another applicable finished-product CTR provision; do not substitute dextrose or refined sugar merely because both are sweeteners.

cases.identity_evidence: Coffee–chicory mixture is a blended finished product under FSSR 2.10.4, separate from separately traded chicory and coffee beans.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: CTR chicory/coffee-bean entries are source-comparison candidates, not proof that the finished blend carries their article limit. The separate ochratoxin-A 'coffee' scope also remains unresolved.
cases.decisive_basis: Blended article differs from individually named ingredients
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Obtain roasted/instant subtype, declared coffee/chicory proportions and an authoritative finished-blend CTR scope determination.

cases.identity_evidence: Coconut milk powder is a dried preparation sourced from Cocos nucifera kernels; maltodextrin and sodium caseinate may be included.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: CTR 'Milks' does not automatically govern the coconut-derived marketed powder solely because its name says milk or caseinate is added.
cases.decisive_basis: Coconut product is not marketed dairy milk
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Establish full formulation and directly applicable finished-product contaminants article; caseinate inclusion needs separate evaluation.

cases.identity_evidence: Cocoa beans are fermented, dried whole Theobroma cacao seeds under FSSR 2.3.54.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Cocoa-powder CTR lead/copper entries have dry fat-free or fat-free analytical bases and cannot be applied to an intact cocoa bean sample as if ground cocoa powder.
cases.decisive_basis: Cocoa beans have a dedicated finished identity
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Find directly named bean provision or authoritative legal scope; test actual bean matrix independently.

cases.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
cases.identity_evidence: Dry mixtures of cocoa and sugars are composite ready-to-consume finished foods, with distinct sugar and cocoa contents.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Cocoa-powder lead/copper entries do not automatically apply to the overall cocoa–sugar mixture on a dry fat-free powder basis.
cases.decisive_basis: Mixed finished product distinct from ingredient cocoa powder
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Obtain composition and formally established mixed-product CTR scope, including analytical sample basis.

cases.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
cases.identity_evidence: Cocoa mass/liquor is milled nib material; cocoa cake is created by removal of fat. FSSR lists their distinct composition columns.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Do not apply the named cocoa-powder CTR rows to mass, liquor or cake without positive scope proof and the actual marketed form and fat-free basis.
cases.decisive_basis: Cocoa powder, mass and press cake are distinct standard forms
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Separate finished subtypes, obtain cocoa fat composition and legal contaminant article.

cases.identity_evidence: Chia seeds are Salvia hispanica from the Labiatae/mint family, a separately listed seed identity.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Chapter placement under cereals does not make chia a cereal grain for the CTR lead row; direct commodity scope must be established.
cases.decisive_basis: Botanical identity is not cereal grain category
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Obtain accepted oilseed/seed classification for metals, crop toxins and pesticide residues.

cases.identity_evidence: Carob powder comes from roasted Ceratonia siliqua pods, not Theobroma cacao.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: An apparently cocoa-like powder cannot inherit named cocoa-powder contaminant rows based on colour/use alone.
cases.decisive_basis: Different botanical source and finished standard
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Identify directly named carob/legume-pod CTR provision and sample basis.

cases.identity_evidence: Arrowroot is purified rhizome starch from Maranta arundinacea or Curcuma angustifolia, not a milled cereal kernel.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: CTR cereal-grain or grain-flour references are not an automatic match for arrowroot rhizome starch.
cases.decisive_basis: Rhizome starch distinct from cereal grain
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Confirm source species and applicable starch or root commodity scope and processing factor.

cases.identity_evidence: Singhara flour is made from Trapa species dried water-chestnut nuts, not milled wheat/rice/maize.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: CTR cereal-grain lead row and milled-grain pesticide descriptions cannot be inherited solely from the name atta.
cases.decisive_basis: Trapa botanical category distinct from cereal grain
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Determine actual food commodity designation in official CTR pesticide/metal tables.

cases.identity_evidence: Salt substitutes may use potassium, calcium, magnesium, ammonium or choline salts and have a separate FSSR composition standard.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Food-grade NaCl/common-salt CTR rows are not automatically a marketed salt-substitute composite article.
cases.decisive_basis: Different statutory product definition and constituent salts
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Verify actual Na/K/Mg composition and separate applicable metal limits or official legal scope.

cases.identity_evidence: Royal jelly is a bee glandular secretion, separately defined from honey and beeswax by FSSR.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Do not take bee-derived honey antibiotic residue rules or beeswax quality limits and assume they govern royal jelly.
cases.decisive_basis: Distinct bee product; no specific CTR named row identified in this review
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Establish royal-jelly contaminant/residue requirements separately and check current specific Gazette references.

cases.identity_evidence: Edible lactose is a separately standardized crystalline disaccharide obtained from milk/whey.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: The CTR 'Milks' lead row is not automatically the correct marketed lactose ingredient article merely because lactose is milk-derived.
cases.decisive_basis: Separate dairy-derived ingredient from marketed fluid milk
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Qualify chemical identity and grade; establish direct finished lactose contaminants applicability.

cases.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
cases.identity_evidence: Colostrum is a secretion in the first days after parturition, preceding normal milk, and has separately standardized products.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Applying the named CTR milk article and concentration rule to raw/dried colostrum without formal scope analysis is unsupported.
cases.decisive_basis: Separate biological secretion from ordinary milks
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Confirm species, post-parturition source, concentration state and legal article scope.

cases.identity_evidence: Soluble dextrin fibre is a purified dextrinification product with specific average polymerisation/indigestible linkages.
cases.excluded_auto_transfer_reason: Its starch origin alone does not show >1.0% finished sulphated ash or identify the high-ash CTR starch-conversion article.
cases.decisive_basis: Processing plus sulphated ash are separate qualifier gates
cases.remaining_positive_evidence: Obtain actual carbohydrate polymer process, sulphated ash on finished matrix and applicable named article.
